test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

​

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12afa337c35c6e1aada8775e49c1f4449d803bf41b2758979aa65b54647f9d89.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: UVQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a433c9ef8b68a19bebeb9a3f4a880d6e1c06876a01530bafb166833a5c10e831.png] 

Option 2: SRM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f823935c29e69b640ebed63d5e17e59dc2f704c877fa464e6e5a5e44b4167a3.png] 

Option 3: EFA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7515ce22fb8e9349372cc4ad6c2e056f372e8884da8ec2c09ab55484681c0366.png] 

Option 4: NOJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57781d453e623c5dfea17a5ea3cfe7d8b9af6a424e3f91c71cfeb2243cf7ddb9.png] 

Thus, SRM does not follow the pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
